scope: Finite information-quantity specification comparability. The contract distinguishes direct comparability from explicit unit-converted comparability and forbids scalar coincidence, shared vocabulary, or shared units from silently substituting for functional, observation, convention, scope, semantic, epistemic, empirical, or physical equivalence.

spec_fields.source_type: declared source/carrier type on which the information quantity is defined
spec_fields.functional: exact information functional identity; shared use of the word information is insufficient
spec_fields.observation: exact observation/measurement contract presented to the functional
spec_fields.unit: declared scalar unit or logarithm-base convention
spec_fields.scope: nonempty contexts/regimes in which the specification is licensed

comparability_modes.direct: source_type, functional, observation, unit, normalization, and conditioning are equal and scopes overlap
comparability_modes.unit_converted: all direct-comparability fields except unit are equal, scopes overlap, and an exact registered positive unit conversion matches the functional and unit direction
comparability_modes.not_authorized: numeric equality, matching codomain, matching unit, matching functional name, or shared use of the word information alone

functional_registry.shannon_entropy: finite Shannon entropy under the declared observation and logarithm-base/unit convention
functional_registry.hartley_entropy: finite Hartley support entropy under the declared observation and logarithm-base/unit convention

execution_limits.policy: The bounded battery is exact conformance evidence for the declared finite specification grammar and bit/base4 conversion registry only; it is not a universal theorem that arbitrary quantities called information are comparable.

explicit_deferrals: mutual-information comparability across unmatched joint models
KL-divergence comparability across unmatched reference measures
stochastic channel comparability to planned PR #17
semantic equivalence between different observation contracts without an explicit bridge
empirical commensurability and calibration validity to planned PR #18
